meta.description: Artifishalis a film about people, rivers, and the fight for the future of wild fish and the environment that supports them. It explores wild salmonâs slide toward extinction, threats posed by fish hatcheries and fish farms, and this culture’s relentless pursuit of engineering, mechanisation, and commodification in the face of environmental collapse. The film shows how fish hatcheries and fish farms threaten wild salmon populations, which in-turn has wide effects on the rest of the environment, but instead of helping wild salmon recover, this culture powers on with hatcheries and farms at great cost, both economically and ecologically.Artifishalexplores the process, and what’s at stake if this culture continues its destructive path.
